card.name: Inside sodium-glucose cotransporter 2
card.fires_on: The pieces of the word cotransporter (co-, transport, -porter, -er) inside the drug class name sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2). It fires just before the number 2 and the SGLT2 abbreviation.

modes.label: Split cotransporter
modes.description: The word cotransporter is broken into pieces such as 'trans', 'porter' or 'er' in the SGLT2 class name.

modes.label: Hyphenated co-transport
modes.description: The 'transport' piece after 'co-' in the same class name, before 'er 2'.
modes.example: patients who received sodium glucose co-<<transport>>er 2 (SGLT2

card.writes: It adds the end of the word transporter, which suggests the class name continues as 'transporter 2'.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of the drug class name sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2).
